subject: mittens
name: Mittens (cat and man, watercolor portrait sketch)

styleSelection.reason: Mostly bare paper with a few painted value planes; dry focal edges at the eyes, brows and nostrils; fine pen lines carry whiskers, lids and curls rather than ink filling any mass.

families.referenceCue: orange tabby head tipped up: broken orange and brown patches over white fur, green eye under a dark upper lid, white muzzle, ears with brown inner tone; pale and mostly paper between the patches
faded chest and shoulder: ragged vertical strips of pale orange on the left and brown patches against the man's cheek, large white paper gaps, soft lost edges
dark blue-grey curly hair as one mottled mass: lighter grey in the lit tufts, darkest at the temple and the hairline, ragged dry-brush edge with white paper flecks
pale warm skin that is mostly paper; sepia shadow along the left cheek and jaw, dark brown brows and upper lids, small eyes, nostril darks, stubble tone around the mouth
